Class TesselWindow

java.lang.Object
javafx.stage.Window
javafx.stage.Stage
net.tessel.fx.components.TesselWindow
All Implemented Interfaces:
javafx.event.EventTarget
Direct Known Subclasses:
TesselDialog
public class TesselWindow extends javafx.stage.Stage
A window with Tessel's own title bar: the icon, the title, any components you add, and minimize / maximize / close buttons, inside a rounded, shadowed frame. It is dragged by the title bar, resized from its edges, and maximized by double-clicking the title bar. 
TesselWindow window = new TesselWindow("My App");
window.getIcons().add(logo);
window.addTitleBarComponent(new Button("..."));
window.setContent(new NavigationView("My App"));
window.setContentSize(1100, 720);
window.show();
It is a Stage, so the usual window API (setTitle, setOnCloseRequest, initOwner, ...) works. Stage.setMaximized(boolean) and Stage.setFullScreen(boolean) are not used; call toggleMaximize(). Size and minimum size are those of the content (setContentSize(double, double), setContentMinSize(double, double)); the frame adds a margin for the shadow.

Unlike Tessel4J's TesselFrame it does not hook into the native window procedure, so Windows 11 Snap Layouts and Aero Snap are not available; dragging, resizing and maximizing are done in JavaFX.
